index:public.index_medication_takes_on_c.definition:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX index_medication_takes_on_client_uuid_canonical ON public.medication_takes USING btree ((
CASE
    WHEN ((client_uuid)::text ~* '^([0-9a-f]{32}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|\{[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\}|urn:uuid:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$'::text) THEN lower(replace(replace(replace(regexp_replace((client_uuid)::text, '^urn:uuid:'::text, ''::text, 'i'::text), '-'::text, ''::text), '{'::text, ''::text), '}'::text, ''::text))
    ELSE NULL::text
END))
